title: Beetle King Stasis 1923
description: A surreal dark fantasy illustration features a towering, gnarled tree with glowing pink and purple energy flowing through its branches like electricity. At the base of the tree, a silhouetted horned figure stands with arms raised on a mound covered in beetles, insects, swords, and bones, with the text 'BEETLE KING STASIS 1923' displayed on a plaque below.
